verdict.rationale: Calendly ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.calendly.com) documented with supported tools (event types, availability, bookings), natural-language-to-API translation, and OAuth DCR auth, and a runtime probe confirms the server is live and speaks the MCP protocol. This directly matches the story's ask for an MCP/tool-calling surface exposing availability, bookings, and event types. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party reports of an agent actually using the Calendly MCP server in production (evidence pack has no community corroboration of MCP usage, only vendor docs and a probe).
